title: Depth model
description: data of: depth.py --model [--free] [--predict --fwhm F --sky S --minutes M] --json. How the magnitude at which half of planted stars are found follows star width, sky brightness and time: mag_50 = constant + time x log10(seconds) - 2.5 log10(FWHM arcsec) + 0.5 sky, fitted to every depth.json kept. The width and sky terms are fixed; the constant and time term are fitted.

time.description: Magnitudes gained per factor of ten in time.

independent.description: Distinct stacks; the steps of one sweep count once.

free.description: Whether the width and sky terms were fitted (--free) or held at -2.5 and +0.5.

scatter.description: Spread of the measurements about the model, magnitudes.
